title: .ticfac/ layout, checkpoint and compare-and-swap rules as schema and fixtures
description: SPEC §10.4 / §12 Phase 0 step 6. Define .ticfac/runs/<id>/{checkpoint.json, attempts/<n>.json, evidence/<key>.json, decisions/<n>.json}, the gitignored .index.json and logs/, the persistence policy (durable means pushed on origin; churn on the run branch; terminal record lands once at publish; run branch tagged at terminal state; ticfac gc) and the compare-and-swap rules (create-if-absent for attempts, SHA-guarded update for checkpoints, against the origin ref). Schemas and golden fixtures in the bundle, plus the .gitignore fragment.
